message.content:
Below is a quick “starter kit” you can copy‑paste into your terminal or adapt to whatever programming language you prefer.  
It shows exactly what needs to be sent to **VirusTotal v3** to attach a comment to the IP `192.168.1.1` using the API key you supplied (`ABC321`).  

> ⚠️ Make sure you keep your API key secret – never commit it to public repos or share it openly.

---

### 1️⃣ Using *cURL* from the shell

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash

API_KEY="ABC321"
TARGET_IP="192.168.1.1"

JSON_PAYLOAD='{
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Confirmed #malware"
    }
}'

curl -sS \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json" \
     -H "x-apikey: $API_KEY" \
     -d "$JSON_PAYLOAD" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?resource=$TARGET_IP"
```

Run it with `chmod +x script.sh && ./script.sh`.  
If everything goes well you’ll see a JSON reply containing the newly created comment’s ID and timestamps.

---

### 2️⃣ Quick Python example (requests)

```python
import os
import json
import requests

API_KEY   = "ABC321"
TARGET_IP = "192.168.1.1"

payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": { "text": "Confirmed #malware" }
}

headers = {
    "accept":          "application/json",
    "content-type":    "application/vnd.api+json",
    "x-apikey":        API_KEY,
}

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?resource={TARGET_IP}"

resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload))

print(resp.status_code)
print(resp.json())
```

Install dependencies first:
```sh
pip install requests
```
Then run the script. You should receive a similar JSON structure back.

---

#### What each part does

| Piece | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `x-apikey` header | Authenticates you against VirusTotal. |
| `resource=` query param | Tells VT which object you’re commenting on (`192.168.1.1` here). |
| Payload JSON | Must follow the [VT schema](https://developers.virustotal.com/reference/post-comment) – `"type"` set to `"comment"` and `"attributes.text"` holding your comment. |

---

### 3️⃣ Common pitfalls & tips

| Issue | Fix |
|------|-----|
| **401 Unauthorized** | Double‑check that the key hasn’t expired or been revoked. |
| **400 Bad Request** | Ensure the JSON matches the required schema; missing fields will trigger errors. |
| **Rate limiting** | If you hit a limit, wait at least a minute before retrying. |
| **Wrong URL** | Use `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/comments?...`; older endpoints (`/api/v2/...`) won’t work with v3. |

---

That’s all! Once executed successfully, the comment will appear under the IP entry in your VirusTotal dashboard. Happy scanning 🚀
